_meta.purpose: Blast-radius census input for every correction round: R1->R2 (findings F1-F7), R3 (the variant-sweep defect), R4 (the USER_LOCKS.pill_palette rewire), R5 (reviewer findings F1-F5), R6 (reviewer findings R5-F1..F4), R7 (reviewer findings R6-F1..F2), and R8 (reviewer finding R7-F1). One entry per value a correction changed. 'old' = the pre-correction phrasing(s); 'new' = the post-correction phrasing(s). 'variants' names every OTHER form the same value plausibly takes in this plan, because a fixed-string sweep cannot find a rephrasing for you.
_meta.receipts: C:/Temp/av-kit/census/census-{slug}-{old|new|variant}-{i}.txt, untruncated, one per swept literal; index at C:/Temp/av-kit/census/INDEX.txt
_meta.scope: implementation-plan.md + task.md (the two plan files). Assert scripts and named-sets.json are swept separately where a value crosses into them.
_meta.variants: Each variant is a searchable LITERAL plus a note saying which other form of the same value it is. The driver sweeps old, new, AND variants -- three directions, one untruncated receipt per literal. Two values declare no variant: row1-deliverable is a single unique sentence, and red-counts is structural (covered by the predicate census, which counts AC rows rather than matching a fixed string).
_meta.round4: The R4 entries below (slugs prefixed r4-) cover the palette rewire the user's colour lock forced: av-kit authors no pill hue, so ten invented --color-pill-*-fg tokens, --color-age-restricted, --color-bg-selected and the 4.60 design margin were all deleted. An OLD literal returning rc=1 is the pass condition for those.
_meta.round5: The R5 entries (slugs prefixed r5-) cover the five Round 4 findings. F1 is the largest: the same-token pill label measured 28/80 against CONTRAST_MIN, so the label moved to --color-fg (80/80, worst CONTRAST_WORST_MEASURED) and the whole pass/debt apparatus -- CONTRAST_AA_PASS, CONTRAST_AA_DEBT, the QUEUE-PILL-AA-DEBT known-issue and its two file keys -- was deleted rather than re-tuned. Those OLD literals returning rc=1 is the pass condition. r5-red-counts is structural and declares no variant; the predicate census covers it by counting AC rows.
_meta.round6: The R6 entries (slugs prefixed r6-) cover Round 5's four findings. Two of them corrected R5's own remedies rather than the original plan: R5-F2 caught an expected kebab set that would have stripped move-down/move-bottom from the top row of every multi-item queue, and R5-F3 caught a confirmation dialog invented against proposal:146-149. r6-services-file-set is self-caught, not reviewer-raised: AC-42.10 and AC-42.11 contradicted the plan's standing claim that services are unchanged. r6-red-counts is structural and declares no variant.
_meta.round7: The R7 entries (slugs prefixed r7-) cover Round 6's two findings, both High, in an extra round the human authorised after Round 6 hit the configured cap. R6-F1 was again a defect in the previous round's remedy: interpolating {quality} into the stored reason is what made it go stale under apply_defaults_to_pending. The fix removes the interpolation rather than adding recomputation, which turns the obligation into an ensure-present invariant. r7-reason-exit-edge is self-caught, not reviewer-raised: clear_sabr moves QualityBlocked -> Pending through transition(), which preserves error_message, so the R6 reason would have outlived its own status. R6-F2 is the first finding in seven rounds that is not a remedy defect - AC-44.2 only ever proved the checkbox. r7-red-counts is structural and declares no variant.
_meta.round8: The R8 entries (slugs prefixed r8-) cover Round 7's single finding. No Round 8 review was dispatched: the human read the Round 7 verdict, directed that the finding be fixed, and approved execution in the same message (USER_EXPLICIT), which is what authorises the plan -> execution transition under plan_to_exec_gate == human. The fix is the reviewer's own first recommendation - centralize at the domain/persistence boundary - which also DELETES the four per-callsite service writes Round 7 had planned, so the net service diff shrinks. r8-clear-narrowness is self-derived: moving the clear to the boundary makes it run on every save, so it had to be narrowed to an exact BLOCKER_REASONS match or it would have erased real Failed tracebacks. r8-red-counts is structural and declares no variant.
